description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Motorola Solutions develops technologies that support public safety and safer communities. The Embedded Software Engineer develops Linux-based embedded software across its lifecycle, including architecture, C++ development, testing, system maintenance, and reuse across production hardware.
Embedded Software Engineer designs and maintains C++ embedded applications, integrates vendor APIs, and builds CI/CD release pipelines.

Responsibilities:
• **Application Development:** Architect, code, and maintain embedded software applications using modern C++
• **System Integration:** Work with vendor-provided APIs/SDKs, define clean software interfaces, and debug complex system-level issues on production hardware
• **Agile Execution:** Author and refine user stories, execute unit and system-level tests, and participate in sprint deliverables within an Agile environment
• **CI/CD Build Pipeline:** Utilize multi-stage continuous integration processes to build, test, and release reliable embedded software loads

Requirements:
• 1+ years of experience in C++ development paired with hands-on exposure to Linux-based embedded systems
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
• Bachelor's degree
• Strong understanding of object-oriented programming in C++ paired with hands-on experience developing Linux-based embedded systems
• Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position

Preferred:
• Experience with low-level systems including Bare Metal C development, Linux Kernel drivers, device trees, and Yocto implementations
• Familiarity with real-time operating system (RTOS) considerations, networking protocols, and CI/CD pipeline management
• Exposure to Linux UI development, Android development, Open Source tools, or embedded neural network applications
